title: Inside the making of Rest&Raw
summary: Our 26-page Unreal Engine 5.7.4 technical report documents island wireframes, interior progress, cloud/mist/fish Blueprints and the provenance of AI-assisted model assets. Browse the illustrated report and accompanying searchable technical notes.

title: A documented library of island assets
summary: The team audited 49 delivered FBX files across modular roofs, harbour construction, gardens, whale display, lighthouse and Taihu rocks. AI-assisted generation is disclosed; actual scene placement and runtime performance are not implied by delivery alone.

title: The bathtub opens the cloud world
summary: The creators confirm that the bathtub transition, visible 60-second countdown and automatic return to the resort were completed and tested by 4 November. The detailed report preserves an earlier in-progress description.

title: The cloud world takes shape
summary: Independent UE 5.7.4 scene development established dynamic cloud generation and recycling, a cloud carpet underfoot, and local fog for depth and orientation.

title: A self-renewing school of fish
summary: Fish now roam on random paths, register touch capture and update a count. Automatic replenishment keeps the world populated, while distant fish are recycled for efficiency.

title: Spatial fish-audio interface prepared
summary: A reusable 3D audio and attenuation interface was added to the fish system before 4 November. Final listen-and-locate playback has not been verified in the technical report.

title: Refining the lobby and upper floor
summary: The latest report shows the lobby and second-floor areas under construction, with the stair route established and the earlier garden concept replaced by a pond landscape. Final furnishing and visual comparison tests are still to be verified.
